title: Secure and observable **by default**
optin.head: On by default · opt-in
optin.items: anonymous API, console and MCP callers refused · `${secret:…}` only from `workflow.http.secrets` · credentials bound to hosts · unsigned Git webhooks refused
tracing (sampling `0.0`) · metrics over OTLP · MCP · sensitive-variable encryption · sharding · process index · analytics rollups
optin.strip: metrics need only a `MeterRegistry`: Actuator + Prometheus → `/actuator/prometheus`, prefix `eventconductor_`
close.line: Secure until told otherwise, **observable when you ask.**
thumb.title: Secure and observable **by default**
